measure: the sample tube needs a blank (empty tube / solvent) recorded with the same method and temperature

relaxation.about: T1 (inversion recovery) or T2 (CPMG) from the last run

measure.message: the lid of {inst} is open; it measures only with the lid closed.
measure.fix: `chemlab run {inst} close lid`.
measure.label: lid closed

measure.message: {inst} has no method set.
measure.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method KEY=VALUE ...` (see `chemlab help {inst} method`).
measure.label: method set

measure.message: there is no sample tube in {inst}.
measure.fix: cells are placed by the lab operator; ask for the sample tube.
measure.label: sample tube in place

set-temp.message: bruker_minispecmq20 has no VT (variable temperature) accessory installed, so it cannot set a sample temperature.
set-temp.fix: measure at the magnet temperature, or ask the lab operator to install the VT accessory.
set-temp.label: VT accessory installed

thermal.set_temperature:UNSUPPORTED.message: bruker_minispecmq20 sets a sample temperature only with the VT accessory installed, and it is not.
thermal.set_temperature:UNSUPPORTED.fix: measure at the magnet temperature, or ask the lab operator to install the VT accessory.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: bruker_minispecmq20 cannot start: it needs power, a method, a tube in and the lid closed.

TEMPLATE_TEMPERATURE_MISMATCH.message: the sample of bruker_minispecmq20 must be at its reference temperature (within 0.1 K) to measure.
TEMPLATE_TEMPERATURE_MISMATCH.fix: set it (`set-temp T --wait`) - the sample's temperature is in the lab's sample sheet.

TIMING_GRID.message: pulse and delay times of bruker_minispecmq20 must be multiples of the 20 ns timing resolution.

DELAY_GRID.message: for inversion recovery the delay list must have `points` increasing values.
DELAY_GRID.fix: give delays=... with as many increasing values as points=.

ECHO_OVERLAP.message: the echo spacing is too short for the 180-degree pulse and receiver dead time.

unsupported.source: the RF transmitter is part of the pulse sequence (not separately switchable)
unsupported.purge: no nitrogen purge control on this instrument
unsupported.load: the cell is placed by the lab operator (no agent capability on this instrument)
unsupported.unload: the cell is placed by the lab operator (no agent capability on this instrument)

alternatives.load: ask the lab operator to change the cell; then `chemlab run bruker_minispecmq20 status`.
alternatives.unload: ask the lab operator to change the cell; then `chemlab run bruker_minispecmq20 status`.

params.manual: minispec mq series user manual E1400011 pp. 33-37 (getting started), 41-60 (measurement and parameter menus); ExpSpel applications manual pp. 33-42 (FID, CPMG examples)

set-temp: needs the VT accessory (probe.vt_installed); without it the instrument answers UNSUPPORTED
